title: Binance Will List Astar (ASTR) in the Innovation Zone
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Astar (ASTR)  in the Innovation Zone and will open trading for  ASTR/BUSD  and  ASTR/USDT  trading pairs at 2022-02-28 11:30 (UTC).  Users can now start depositing  ASTR   in preparation for trading Withdrawals for ASTR will open at 2022-03-01 11:30 (UTC) Note:  The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status of withdrawals on the withdrawal page. ASTR Listing Fee: 0 BNB. What is Astar (ASTR)? Astar Network is a multi-chain dApp hub on Polkadot that supports the Ethereum Virtual Machine, Web Assembly, and Layer 2 solutions. ASTR is the utility and governance token of the network. ASTR token holders can participate in network governance, pay transaction fees, and earn rewards through staking the token. Reminder :  The Innovation Zone is a dedicated trading zone where users are able to trade new, innovative tokens that are likely to have higher volatility and pose a higher risk than other tokens. Before being able to trade in the Innovation Zone, all users are required to visit the web version of the Innovation Zone trading page to carefully read the  Binance Terms of Use  and complete a questionnaire as part of the Initial Disclaimer. Please note that there will not be any trading restrictions on trading pairs in the Innovation Zone. ASTR is a relatively new token that poses a higher than normal risk, and as such will likely be subject to high price volatility. Please ensure that you exercise sufficient risk management, have done your own research in regards to ASTR’s fundamentals, and fully understand the project before opting to trade the token.
